entity_types.name: Politician
entity_types.description: Elected officials or party leaders involved in Thai domestic politics and legislative processes.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the politician

attributes.name: political_party
attributes.description: The party the politician is currently affiliated with

attributes.name: current_office
attributes.description: The specific government or legislative position held

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Officials representing Thailand or Cambodia in international relations and border negotiations.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the diplomat

attributes.name: assigned_country
attributes.description: The country where the diplomat is stationed or represents

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The official rank such as Ambassador or Consul

entity_types.name: MilitaryOfficer
entity_types.description: High-ranking personnel in the armed forces involved in border security and national defense.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name and rank of the officer

attributes.name: command_unit
attributes.description: The specific military unit or region under their command

attributes.name: military_branch
attributes.description: Army, Navy, or Air Force

examples: Commander of the Second Army Region

entity_types.name: Economist
entity_types.description: Experts and analysts who comment on Thai economic trends, trade, and currency stability.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the economist

attributes.name: institution
attributes.description: The university, bank, or research institute they belong to

attributes.name: expertise_area
attributes.description: Specific focus like macroeconomics or trade policy

entity_types.name: Journalist
entity_types.description: Media professionals reporting on political developments and the Thai-Cambodian conflict.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the journalist

attributes.name: media_affiliation
attributes.description: The news outlet or platform they work for

attributes.name: reporting_beat
attributes.description: The specific topic they cover, e.g., Foreign Affairs

entity_types.name: PoliticalParty
entity_types.description: Formal organizations competing for power in the 2026 Thai elections.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The official name of the political party

attributes.name: ideology
attributes.description: The primary political or economic stance of the party

attributes.name: headquarters_location
attributes.description: The main office location

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: State institutions responsible for policy implementation and international affairs.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The official name of the agency

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The area of governance they control

attributes.name: head_official
attributes.description: The current leader of the agency

examples: National Economic and Social Development Council

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals or group leaders advocating for social change or nationalist causes.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the activist or group leader

attributes.name: primary_cause
attributes.description: The main issue they are campaigning for

attributes.name: affiliation_group
attributes.description: The movement or NGO they represent

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: General individuals, netizens, or citizens participating in social media discourse.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name or handle of the individual

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: The city or province where they reside

attributes.name: user_bio
attributes.description: Short description of the person's interests

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: General groups, small businesses, or NGOs not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization

attributes.name: sector_type
attributes.description: The industry or social sector they operate in

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: The primary goal of the organization

edge_types.name: MEMBER_OF
edge_types.description: Indicates a person belongs to a specific political or organizational group.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: A journalist or media entity providing information about a subject.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Formal diplomatic or political discussions between two parties.

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Public expression of disapproval or opposition on social media.

edge_types.name: ADVISES
edge_types.description: Providing expert opinion or guidance on policy or economics.

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.description: Expressing agreement or providing resources to a cause or party.

edge_types.name: MONITORS
edge_types.description: Observing actions, particularly regarding border security or economic shifts.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex interplay between Thai domestic politics, economic forecasting for 2026, and the geopolitical tension with Cambodia. It focuses on key actors like politicians, diplomats, and military officers who drive official narratives, while including journalists, economists, and activists who shape public opinion and social media discourse. Fallback types ensure all social media participants can be categorized.
simulation_requirement: analyze and predict thai politics and economics 2026 and the conflict with Cambodia
